blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Supreme Court Chief Justice Rodil Zalameda on Monday urged the Court of Appeals (CA) to swiftly resolve pending appeals in the Maguindanao massacre case, saying the victims and their families had waited long enough for justice, 17 years after the killings. Speaking during his first flag-raising ceremony as chief justice, Zalameda called on the appellate court to act on the outstanding appeals while respecting the rights of all parties. “As we speak of protecting those who stand for justice, we must also remember the victims of the Ampatuan Massacre, whose 17th anniversary we commemorate today.
